checklist.title: EIP-1571 Stratum Hex Format Validation
checklist.detection_procedure: At trust boundary, verify hex values in Stratum protocol messages are lowercase, have no 0x prefix, and use the minimum number of significant digits. Malformed hex must be rejected.
executable_checks: Send Stratum message with uppercase hex
Send properly formatted hex (lowercase, no prefix, minimal)
checklist.notes: CRITICAL boundary check. Hex format validation prevents ambiguous interpretations that could cause mining work errors.

checklist.title: EIP-1571 Mining Job Notification Validation
checklist.detection_procedure: At trust boundary, verify mining jobs received via mining.notify contain a valid job ID, block number, and header hash in correct hex format before the miner begins hashing.
executable_checks: Send mining.notify with missing job ID
Send mining.notify with invalid block number format
Send mining.notify with malformed header hash
checklist.notes: CRITICAL trust boundary. Invalid mining jobs could cause miners to waste computational resources on invalid work.

checklist.title: EIP-1571 Session Error Counter Monotonicity
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify the session error counter monotonically increases for each error detected and the server disconnects the client when the counter reaches or exceeds the maxerrors threshold. Counter must never decrease.
executable_checks: Trigger session errors and verify counter increments
Test counter persists across message exchanges
Confirm no counter reset without session restart
checklist.notes: Error counter enforcement prevents abusive clients from repeatedly sending malformed messages without consequences.

checklist.title: EIP-1884 BALANCE and EXTCODEHASH Gas Cost
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify BALANCE and EXTCODEHASH opcodes require at least 700 gas remaining per the EIP-1884 repriced schedule. Insufficient gas must cause out-of-gas error.
checklist.notes: Gas cost enforcement prevents contracts from executing operations they cannot afford, maintaining economic security.

checklist.title: EIP-1884 SELFBALANCE Execution and Gas Cost
checklist.detection_procedure: After SELFBALANCE (0x47) executes successfully, verify the EVM stack contains the current contract's balance at the top, and exactly 5 gas has been consumed. Result must match BALANCE(ADDRESS) but cost less.
executable_checks: Execute SELFBALANCE in contract with balance X
Verify X is pushed to stack top
Execute ADDRESS then BALANCE for same contract
Verify SELFBALANCE result equals BALANCE(ADDRESS) result
Confirm SELFBALANCE costs 5 gas vs BALANCE's 700+ gas
checklist.notes: SELFBALANCE optimization reduces gas cost for common operation. Incorrect implementation would negate efficiency gains.

checklist.title: EIP-100 Difficulty Adjustment Factor Bounds
checklist.detection_procedure: After computing the adjustment factor, verify the result is bounded between -99 and uncle_factor (1 or 2), inclusive. Formula: max(uncle_factor - ((timestamp - parent.timestamp) // 9), -99).
executable_checks: Compute adjustment with very large timestamp difference
Verify result is uncle_factor (1 or 2 based on uncles)
Confirm all results in [-99, uncle_factor] range
checklist.notes: CRITICAL consensus invariant. Unbounded adjustment factors would cause difficulty spikes or crashes, destabilizing block time.

checklist.title: Prague RETURNDATACOPY Bounds Validation
checklist.detection_procedure: For RETURNDATACOPY, verify that offset + size does not exceed the current return data buffer size. Violation must cause an immediate execution revert with proper error.
executable_checks: Execute RETURNDATACOPY with offset + size > returndata_size
Verify immediate revert with bounds error
Execute with offset + size = returndata_size (exact boundary)
Test integer overflow in offset + size calculation
checklist.notes: CRITICAL bounds check. Out-of-bounds returndata access could leak memory contents or cause undefined behavior.

checklist.title: Prague BLOBHASH Index Bounds Check
checklist.detection_procedure: After BLOBHASH executes with an index within bounds of blob_versioned_hashes, verify the correct versioned hash is on the stack. If out of bounds, zero must be pushed.
executable_checks: Execute BLOBHASH with index 0 in transaction with 3 blobs
Verify correct hash from blob_versioned_hashes[0] is pushed
Execute BLOBHASH with index 3 (out of bounds)
Execute BLOBHASH with negative index (treated as large uint)
checklist.notes: Out-of-bounds behavior (returning zero) is consensus-critical. Revert or error would break existing blob-aware contracts.

checklist.title: EIP-3607 Sender CodeHash Validation
checklist.detection_procedure: At trust boundary, before a transaction is accepted, retrieve the sender's CodeHash from state and verify it equals EMPTYCODEHASH (0xc5d2460186f7233c927e7db2dcc703c0e500b653ca82273b7bfad8045d85a470). Non-empty code must cause rejection.
executable_checks: Submit transaction from address with deployed contract code
Test with address that has code but zero balance
Test rejection occurs after nonce verification
checklist.notes: CRITICAL trust boundary check. Prevents address collision attacks where attackers deploy code at collision address then submit transactions.

checklist.title: EIP-3607 Address Collision Attack Prevention
checklist.detection_procedure: After an address collision attack sequence where an attacker finds a collision address and deploys code, verify any subsequent transaction from that address is rejected by EIP-3607.
executable_checks: Simulate address collision (attacker finds address with matching CREATE2)
Deploy contract code at collision address
Attempt to submit transaction from collision address
Confirm attack is blocked regardless of private key knowledge
checklist.notes: CRITICAL attack mitigation. EIP-3607 prevents exploitation of address collisions by making contract addresses unusable as transaction senders.

checklist.title: EIP-7805 Inclusion List Slot Validation
checklist.detection_procedure: At trust boundary, verify the slot in an inclusion list message equals the current slot or the previous slot. Messages with any other slot value must be REJECTED with peer penalty.
executable_checks: Send inclusion list with slot = current_slot
Send inclusion list with slot = current_slot - 1
Send inclusion list with slot = current_slot + 1 (future)
Send inclusion list with slot = current_slot - 2 (old)
checklist.notes: CRITICAL boundary validation. Slot restriction prevents replay attacks and ensures inclusion lists are timely.

checklist.title: EIP-7805 REJECT vs IGNORE Peer Penalty Distinction
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify REJECT-level validation failures always penalize the sending peer's score, while IGNORE-level failures never penalize. This distinction must be maintained throughout the validation pipeline.
executable_checks: Test multiple REJECT failures accumulate penalties
Verify IGNORE failures are silently dropped
checklist.notes: Peer penalty distinction is critical for network health. Penalizing IGNORE-level failures would enable DoS attacks through benign rate limiting.

checklist.title: Prague BLOCKHASH Lookback Range Enforcement
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify BLOCKHASH returns zero for: future blocks (number > current), the current block (number == current), and blocks older than 256 blocks (number < current - 256). Only blocks in range [current-256, current-1] return the actual hash.
executable_checks: Execute BLOCKHASH for current block number
Confirm actual block hash is returned
checklist.notes: BLOCKHASH range enforcement prevents miners from manipulating future or old block hashes, maintaining randomness source integrity.

checklist.title: Cancun BYTE Index Bounds Handling
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify BYTE(i, x) returns the byte at big-endian position i (0=most significant) from the 256-bit word x. For i >= 32, it must return 0.
executable_checks: Verify least significant byte is returned
Confirm zero is returned (out of bounds)
checklist.notes: BYTE bounds handling is consensus-critical. Incorrect out-of-bounds behavior could cause arithmetic errors in contracts.

checklist.title: Cancun Shift Overflow Handling
checklist.detection_procedure: For shift >= 256: verify SHL and SHR return 0. SAR must return 0 if the input is non-negative, or MAX_VALUE (2^256-1) if the input is negative (sign bit set).
checklist.notes: Shift overflow handling is critical for arithmetic correctness. SAR sign extension for large shifts maintains two's complement semantics.

checklist.title: Prague DUP_N Stack Depth Validation
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify DUP_N requires the stack to have at least N elements (item_number < len(stack)). If the stack is too shallow, execution must halt with StackUnderflowError.
executable_checks: Execute DUP5 with stack of 4 elements
Execute DUP5 with stack of 5 elements
Test all DUP1-DUP16 with appropriate stack depths
checklist.notes: CRITICAL stack bounds check. Stack underflow could expose internal memory or cause undefined behavior.

checklist.title: ECRECOVER Fixed Gas Cost
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify the ecrecover precompile always consumes exactly 3000 gas (GAS_ECRECOVER) regardless of whether the recovery succeeds or fails. No variable gas cost allowed.
executable_checks: Call ecrecover with invalid signature (recovery fails)
Confirm gas consumed is still exactly 3000
Verify all cases consume identical gas
checklist.notes: Fixed gas cost prevents gas estimation attacks and ensures predictable precompile pricing.

checklist.title: EIP-7514 Linear Growth Rate Enforcement
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify post-EIP-7514, validator set growth is linear (bounded by constant per-epoch cap) rather than exponential (scaling with validator set size). Growth rate must not exceed 8 validators per epoch.
executable_checks: Measure validator set growth before EIP-7514
Confirm exponential scaling (based on set size)
Verify growth limited to 8 per epoch regardless of set size
checklist.notes: CRITICAL consensus property. Linear growth prevents validator set explosion that could threaten network stability and decentralization.

checklist.title: EIP-7934 Early Rejection of Malicious Oversized Blocks
checklist.detection_procedure: At trust boundary, verify an oversized block from a malicious peer is rejected via early size check before signature verification or state transition processing. Measure rejection happens early.
executable_checks: Receive block with RLP size 10 MB from peer
Confirm no signature verification is performed
Verify no state transition processing occurs
Measure time to rejection - should be minimal
Confirm peer may be penalized for sending oversized block
checklist.notes: CRITICAL DoS mitigation. Early rejection prevents resource exhaustion from malicious peers sending computationally expensive invalid blocks.

checklist.title: EIP-7801 Historical Data Retrieval via Etha
checklist.detection_procedure: After identifying peers with matching bitmasks and sending data requests, verify the node receives the requested block bodies or receipts, or detects data unavailability. Timeout handling must be robust.
executable_checks: Identify peers with bitmask covering target block range
Send request for historical block bodies
Verify data is received and validated
Request data from peers with non-matching bitmask
Test timeout handling for non-responsive peers
checklist.notes: Historical data retrieval is critical for sync and archive nodes. Robust unavailability detection prevents indefinite waiting.

checklist.title: EIP-2929 Access Set Reversion on Call Failure
checklist.detection_procedure: When a call context reverts, verify all access set modifications made within that scope are reverted, restoring access sets to the pre-call state. Cold addresses must remain cold.
executable_checks: Create nested call that accesses cold address then reverts
Verify address is NOT in access set after revert
Test subsequent access to same address is cold (2600 gas)
Create successful call that accesses cold address
Verify address remains in access set (warm)
checklist.notes: Access set reversion is critical for gas pricing isolation. Leaked access set data from reverted calls would enable gas manipulation attacks.

checklist.title: EIP-3855 PUSH0 Program Counter Advancement
checklist.detection_procedure: After PUSH0 executes successfully, verify the program counter advances by exactly 1 (no immediate data bytes). PC increment must be consistent with other stack-only opcodes.
executable_checks: Compare with PUSH1 which advances PC by 2 (opcode + 1 byte data)
Confirm no immediate data is consumed
checklist.notes: PC advancement correctness is fundamental for control flow. Incorrect PC handling would cause execution of wrong instructions.

checklist.title: Keccak Hash Integrity Verification
checklist.detection_procedure: After hash comparison, verify matching hashes confirm data integrity while mismatching hashes indicate data corruption or tampering. Hash comparison must be constant-time to prevent timing attacks.
executable_checks: Compute hash of data and store
Measure comparison time - should be constant
checklist.notes: Hash-based integrity checks are fundamental to blockchain security. Timing attacks on hash comparison could leak information.

checklist.title: EIP-7825 Block Rejection for Transaction Limit Violation
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify a block containing any transaction with gasLimit > 16,777,216 is rejected entirely. Block rejection must be deterministic across all nodes.
executable_checks: Include transaction with gasLimit = 16,777,217 in block
Confirm block is not added to chain
Verify block is not propagated to peers
Confirm single violation invalidates entire block
checklist.notes: CRITICAL consensus rule. Block-level rejection ensures consistent validation across all nodes.

checklist.title: Ethash Mix Digest Compression
checklist.detection_procedure: After all 64 iterations, verify the mix is compressed into a 32-byte mix digest via FNV-combining 4-element groups. Compression must be deterministic and produce correct digest for final hash.
executable_checks: Verify mix compression produces exactly 32 bytes
Confirm FNV combining is applied to each 4-element group
Test compression is deterministic (same mix → same digest)
Verify digest is used in final PoW hash calculation
checklist.notes: Mix compression is critical for PoW verification. Incorrect compression would invalidate all mining work.

checklist.title: EIP-1571 Session ID Generation and Uniqueness
checklist.detection_procedure: After a successful mining.subscribe, verify the session ID returned by the server is unique and unpredictable, and the session is recorded in the server's session cache for resumption.
executable_checks: Confirm session ID is cryptographically random (unpredictable)
Test session ID uniqueness across multiple subscriptions
Verify session is stored in server cache
Confirm session can be resumed using returned ID
checklist.notes: Session ID security prevents session hijacking. Predictable IDs would enable attackers to resume other clients' sessions.

checklist.title: EIP-1884 SLOAD Breaking 2300 Gas Stipend
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify contracts using SLOAD within a 2300 gas stipend (transfer/send fallback) always revert after EIP-1884 activation, since 800 > 2300 - LOG overhead. This is expected breaking change.
executable_checks: Create contract with fallback that does LOG + SLOAD
Before EIP-1884: verify transfer succeeds (SLOAD cost 200)
After EIP-1884: confirm transfer reverts (SLOAD cost 800)
Verify this is documented breaking change
checklist.notes: CRITICAL breaking change. Contracts relying on SLOAD in 2300 gas stipend will break after EIP-1884. Developers must adapt.

checklist.title: EIP-100 Child Difficulty Computation Formula
checklist.detection_procedure: After difficulty computation, verify child difficulty equals parent.difficulty + (parent.difficulty // 2048) * adjustment_factor. The difficulty must never be zero.
executable_checks: Confirm difficulty decreases but never reaches zero
Test minimum difficulty floor is enforced
checklist.notes: CRITICAL consensus formula. Incorrect difficulty calculation would cause block time instability and potential chain splits.

checklist.title: Prague BLOBBASEFEE Execution
checklist.detection_procedure: After BLOBBASEFEE executes, verify the current blob base fee from the block environment is pushed to the stack, and GAS_BASE gas is consumed. Value must reflect current market conditions.
executable_checks: Verify blob base fee is pushed to stack
Confirm exactly GAS_BASE (2 gas) is consumed
Compare value to block's blob base fee
Test blob fee changes across blocks are reflected
checklist.notes: BLOBBASEFEE provides market fee data to contracts. Incorrect value would break blob fee-aware contract logic.

checklist.title: EIP-3607 RPC Simulation Code Check Bypass
checklist.detection_procedure: At RPC boundary, verify for eth_call and eth_estimateGas simulation requests, the EIP-3607 sender code check may be skipped to allow simulation of transactions from contract addresses. Real transactions must always enforce the check.
executable_checks: Send eth_sendRawTransaction from same contract address
Confirm bypass only applies to simulation, not real tx
checklist.notes: RPC simulation bypass enables useful contract interaction testing without breaking EIP-3607 security for real transactions.

checklist.title: EIP-7805 Inclusion List Size Limit Enforcement
checklist.detection_procedure: At trust boundary, verify inclusion list messages received on gossipsub have transaction data size within MAX_BYTES_PER_INCLUSION_LIST (8192 bytes). Messages exceeding this limit must be REJECTED with peer score penalty.
executable_checks: Send inclusion list with tx data exactly 8192 bytes
Send inclusion list with tx data 8193 bytes
Test penalty is applied to sending peer
Verify oversized messages are not propagated
checklist.notes: CRITICAL boundary DoS protection. Size limit prevents malicious validators from flooding network with large inclusion lists.

checklist.title: Prague BLOCKHASH vs Other Block Opcodes Gas Cost
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify BLOCKHASH charges exactly GAS_BLOCK_HASH (20 gas), while all other block context opcodes charge exactly GAS_BASE (2 gas). These costs are fixed and must not vary by execution context.
executable_checks: Test gas costs are independent of block number
Verify costs are consistent across all contexts
checklist.notes: Gas cost consistency is consensus-critical. Variable costs would enable gas estimation attacks and break determinism.

checklist.title: Cancun Shift Operations with Normal Shift Amount
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify SHL with shift < 256 returns (value << shift) masked to 2^256-1. SHR returns value >> shift (zero-filled). SAR returns arithmetic right shift (sign-extended). All must handle two's complement correctly.
executable_checks: Execute SAR(4, -256) where -256 in two's complement
Verify sign extension produces correct negative result
Test edge cases: shift by 0, shift by 255
Confirm all operations preserve arithmetic semantics
checklist.notes: Shift operations are fundamental for bit manipulation. Incorrect arithmetic semantics would break contract calculations.

checklist.title: Prague PUSH_N Stack and PC Effects
checklist.detection_procedure: After PUSH_N executes, verify the stack has one additional element (the N-byte big-endian value read from bytecode), and the program counter has advanced by 1+N positions. Both effects must occur atomically.
executable_checks: Execute PUSH1 0x42 with initial stack size 5
Verify PC advanced by 2 (opcode + 1 immediate byte)
Test big-endian value interpretation is correct
checklist.notes: PUSH_N is most common opcode. Incorrect stack/PC effects would break virtually all contracts.

checklist.title: ECRECOVER Parameter s Range Validation
checklist.detection_procedure: At trust boundary, verify the ecrecover parameter s satisfies 0 < s < SECP256K1N. Values outside this range must cause an empty return (not revert). Both high-s and low-s values within range are accepted.
executable_checks: Call ecrecover with valid low-s value
Call ecrecover with valid high-s value (s > SECP256K1N/2)
checklist.notes: Parameter s validation with high-s acceptance maintains backward compatibility while rejecting invalid curve points.

checklist.title: EIP-7514 Activation Churn Limit Calculation
checklist.detection_procedure: After activation churn limit computation, verify the result equals min(get_validator_churn_limit(state), MAX_PER_EPOCH_ACTIVATION_CHURN_LIMIT). Both components must be calculated correctly.
executable_checks: Compute churn limit with small validator set
Verify min() selects validator churn limit (smaller)
Compute churn limit with large validator set (>65536)
checklist.notes: CRITICAL consensus calculation. Incorrect min() selection would cause validator activation rate errors.

checklist.title: EIP-7934 Block Construction Size Limit Enforcement
checklist.detection_procedure: During block construction, verify the validator does not add a transaction that would cause the block to exceed MAX_RLP_BLOCK_SIZE. Size estimation must be accurate to prevent invalid block creation.
executable_checks: Add transaction that would exceed limit
Confirm block remains under size limit
Verify finalized block size matches estimation
checklist.notes: Validator-side enforcement prevents creation of invalid blocks that would be rejected by the network.

checklist.title: EIP-7801 Block Data Retention vs Bitmask
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify block data falling within a node's bitmask-committed spans is retained, while block data outside committed spans may be pruned. Retention must match advertised bitmask.
executable_checks: Configure node with specific block span bitmask
Verify blocks within committed spans are retained
Confirm blocks outside spans are pruned (or not stored)
checklist.notes: Bitmask enforcement ensures nodes only advertise data they actually retain, preventing false availability claims.

checklist.title: EIP-2929 CREATE/CREATE2 Address Set Addition
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify CREATE/CREATE2 adds the newly created contract address to accessed_addresses as part of the creation operation. Subsequent accesses must be warm.
executable_checks: Verify access is warm (100 gas, not 2600 gas)
Confirm created address is immediately warm
Test address is added even if creation fails
checklist.notes: Immediate warming of created addresses prevents unexpected gas spikes when accessing newly deployed contracts.

checklist.title: EIP-3855 PUSH0 Fork Activation Behavior
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify before EIP-3855 activation, opcode 0x5f is treated as an invalid opcode causing execution failure. After activation it must execute as PUSH0. Fork transition must be deterministic.
executable_checks: Test fork activation block is deterministic across nodes
checklist.notes: CRITICAL consensus fork transition. Opcode 0x5f behavior change must activate simultaneously across all nodes.

checklist.title: Keccak Hash Collision Resistance
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify attackers cannot find Keccak256 or Keccak512 collisions in practical time. The security of state roots, transaction hashes, and address derivation depends on collision resistance. This is a cryptographic assumption.
executable_checks: Generate many random inputs and compute hashes
Verify no collisions found (extremely low probability)
Test state root integrity depends on hash collision resistance
Confirm transaction hash uniqueness relies on collision resistance
Verify CREATE2 address derivation security assumes no collisions
Document this as cryptographic security assumption
checklist.notes: CRITICAL cryptographic assumption. Keccak collision resistance is fundamental to all blockchain security. Hash function compromise would break consensus.

checklist.title: EIP-7825 Gas Cap DoS Prevention
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify the gas cap enforcement bounds block validation time to predictable limits, preventing DoS attacks via resource-exhausting transactions. Measure validation time with various gas limits.
executable_checks: Validate block with transaction at gas cap (16,777,216)
Attempt to create transaction exceeding cap
Verify immediate rejection without full validation
Confirm validation time is bounded regardless of transaction complexity
Test cap prevents unbounded resource consumption
checklist.notes: CRITICAL DoS protection. Gas cap ensures predictable block validation time, preventing network-wide validation slowdowns.

checklist.title: Ethash Hashimoto Loop Iteration Count
checklist.detection_procedure: Verify the hashimoto verification loop executes exactly 64 iterations, each accessing 2 dataset rows, for a total of 128 dataset accesses. Iteration count must be fixed regardless of inputs.
executable_checks: Count total loop iterations - verify exactly 64
Count dataset row accesses - verify exactly 128 (2 per iteration)
Test with various header hashes and nonces
checklist.notes: CRITICAL PoW algorithm invariant. Fixed iteration count ensures consistent work difficulty. Variable iterations would enable mining optimization attacks.
